fields.name: ignoreBots
fields.description: If enabled, requests from known bots (crawlers, spiders) will be ignored.

fields.name: ipAllowlist
fields.description: Comma-separated list of IPs or CIDR ranges. Only these IPs can trigger the webhook.

fields.name: noResponseBody
fields.description: If enabled, the webhook will respond with an empty body (only status code).

fields.name: rawBody
fields.description: If enabled, the raw request body will be passed as-is without parsing.

fields.name: responseData
fields.description: Custom response data to return when the webhook is triggered (JSON or text).

inputs.query:
with new_org as (
  insert into organizations (name, slug)
  values ($1, lower(regexp_replace($1, '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '-', 'g'))
              || '-' || substr(md5(random()::text), 1, 6))
  returning id, name
), new_user as (
  insert into users (email, full_name, password_hash, auth_provider)
  values (lower($2), $3, $4, 'password')
  returning id, email, full_name, avatar_url
), new_membership as (
  insert into memberships (user_id, org_id, role)
  select new_user.id, new_org.id, 'owner'::membership_role
  from new_user, new_org
  returning role
)
select new_user.id        as user_id,
       new_user.email     as email,
       new_user.full_name as full_name,
       new_org.id         as org_id,
       new_org.name       as org_name,
       'owner'            as role
from new_user, new_org;
